Gram.et: From Middle High German gram (“displeasure, anger”), from Old High German *gramo, from Proto-Germanic *gramô (“anger”). Cognate with English grame. Akin also to Old Norse gramr (“wroth”) (whence the name of the sword), French and English chagrin.

grammatikalisch.et: From Latin grammaticalis. Analysable as Grammatik + -al + -isch.

grammatisch.et: From Latin grammaticus, from Ancient Greek γραμματικός (grammatikós). Analysable as Grammatik + -isch.
